design_notes: All four example locations are physically in Texas; profile matches must be chosen explicitly.
AI recognizes the item; an exact item_key matches a documented rule for the chosen collection program.
An unknown item must return default_message, not an AI-generated guess about this program.
Home profile applies only to City of Frisco residential service subscribers, not everyone with a Frisco ZIP.
UT Dallas policies refer to designated campus bins and collection streams. Compost is available only where explicitly marked.
H-E-B and Best Buy examples are publicly documented CUSTOMER drop-off programs, NOT verified employee trash/recycling contracts.
For a not_accepted_here rule, never translate that status to trash; it only means the specified drop-off program does not accept the item.
Check each official policy periodically; these are source-backed snapshots, not live guarantees of opening hours, eligibility, or operational status.
Home profiles are out of the institution selector; ZIP is used only in Find a Place.
Frisco ISD examples describe district activities, not verified per-campus daily bin rules; never claim permanent bag/battery acceptance.
Customer store collection programs must not be presented as employee or office sorting policies.
Food-chain examples are brand-specific post-consumer packaging/reuse guidance, NOT confirmed local-bin acceptance at named Frisco stores.
Aluminum trays have a verified positive entry only for TDS (exact named item); do not propagate to other institution profiles.
Raspberry Pi acceptance is not listed verbatim by local electronics recyclers, so show Confirm with recycling center status instead of a guaranteed drop-off.

AA describes battery size, not battery chemistry. Generic AA scans follow household-battery guidance; explicitly alkaline AA uses an alkaline-specific school rule. All school guidance is conditional special collection, never guaranteed campus acceptance.

status_values.special_dropoff: Dedicated collection program or drop-off, not curbside bin
status_values.not_accepted_here: This designated drop-off program rejects this item; alternate disposal not determined
status_values.reuse: A published waste-prevention/reuse action, not a recycling-bin placement
status_values.check_local_recycling: Recyclability/brand packaging guidance exists but local collection acceptance is not verified
status_values.verify_dropoff: Documented broad electronics category; exact board requires facility confirmation

profiles.name: Purefoy Elementary
profiles.policy_type: district-published collections; exact campus bin policy unverified
profiles.scope: Purefoy Elementary is part of Frisco ISD. The district describes classroom recycling and schoolwide bag-film/battery drives; this does not verify permanent bins, exact materials, or drive dates at this campus.
profiles.default_message: Frisco ISD has not published an item-specific bin rule for this campus in the sources reviewed. Ask the Green Team coordinator or custodial staff before using a bin.

plastic_grocery_bag.instruction: Frisco ISD runs plastic bag/film recycling drives. Ask campus staff whether a drive is currently accepting clean eligible bags; do not assume a regular school recycling bin accepts film.
plastic_grocery_bag.condition: Only at an announced active campus collection drive.

household_battery.instruction: Frisco ISD organizes battery recycling drives. Ask the school which battery types can be safely brought and when the event is running; never place batteries in regular recycling.
household_battery.condition: Only at an announced drive and if the battery type is accepted.

alkaline_battery.instruction: Frisco ISD organizes school battery recycling drives. Ask school staff whether an active drive is accepting AA alkaline batteries, then follow their drop-off instructions. Do not put batteries in normal recycling bins.
alkaline_battery.condition: Collection is only possible during an active drive that accepts AA alkaline batteries.

profiles.name: The University of Texas at Dallas — campus collection programs
profiles.scope: University of Texas at Dallas campus sorting and specialty collection; only use a specific compost or special collection station where campus provides it. This is NOT a policy for all Texas schools.
profiles.default_message: UT Dallas has no verified sorting rule here for this item. Check the bin label or contact campus recycling at recycling@utdallas.edu.

plastic_bottle.instruction: Empty the bottle and use a designated campus single-stream recycling bin.

glass_bottle.instruction: Put empty, unbroken glass bottles in the campus recycling stream.
glass_bottle.condition: Unbroken glass only; follow the bin sign.

aluminum_can.instruction: Rinse and place the can in a campus recycling bin.

metal_can.instruction: Rinse the metal food can and use campus recycling.

clean_cardboard.instruction: Flatten clean cardboard and place it in an appropriate campus recycling container.

paper.instruction: Use a campus single-stream recycling bin for clean paper.

newspaper.instruction: Recycle newspapers and magazines in a campus recycling bin.

food_scraps.instruction: Use a marked campus compost collection point where it is provided; do not put food in single-stream recycling.
food_scraps.condition: Compost collection is only available at designated sites, not every UT Dallas bin.

food_wrapper.instruction: Put ordinary food wrappers in trash rather than the campus blue recycling bin.
food_wrapper.condition: For clean recyclable specialty film, check the campus specialty collection program first.

foam_takeout_tray.instruction: Place used Styrofoam food containers in trash, not normal campus single-stream recycling.
foam_takeout_tray.condition: Special clean foam recycling, if any, is a separate stream.

household_battery.instruction: Use UT Dallas designated battery recycling collection, not an ordinary bin.
household_battery.condition: Follow campus battery safety instructions and collection-site eligibility.

alkaline_battery.instruction: UT Dallas has designated battery recycling collection. Ask the campus recycling team whether your AA alkaline battery is accepted, and take it only to an approved battery collection point—not a regular recycling bin.
alkaline_battery.condition: A designated battery collection point must accept this battery type.

cell_phone.instruction: Ask the campus electronics-recycling program about an appropriate collection point.
cell_phone.condition: Campus specialty electronic-waste collection only; check availability and eligibility.

plastic_wrap.instruction: Check UT Dallas specialty plastic-wrap recycling locations, not the normal blue bin.
plastic_wrap.condition: Only eligible film and designated campus collection points.

raspberry_pi.instruction: UT Dallas provides specialty collection for electronics. Ask the campus recycling team whether it accepts a bare Raspberry Pi board before using a designated electronics collection location.
raspberry_pi.condition: Campus-specific and equipment ownership rules apply.

profiles.name: UT Dallas Campus Offices
profiles.policy_type: university campus office single-stream and special collection
profiles.scope: Applies only to offices on UT Dallas's Richardson campus that use the university's designated recycling and specialty-collection services. Not a rule for unrelated offices.
profiles.default_message: UT Dallas has not published a specific rule for this item in the reviewed campus office guidance. Check the campus recycling guide or Facilities.

plastic_bottle.instruction: Empty the plastic bottle and use a designated UT Dallas campus single-stream recycling bin.

aluminum_can.instruction: Empty the can and use a campus single-stream recycling bin.

clean_cardboard.instruction: Flatten clean, dry cardboard and use campus recycling.

paper.instruction: Place clean office paper in campus single-stream recycling; confidential documents may require separate secure shredding.

glass_bottle.instruction: Empty an intact glass bottle and use designated campus single-stream recycling.

household_battery.instruction: Use a designated UT Dallas battery collection point; do not put batteries in the mixed recycling bin.

printer_cartridge.instruction: Use a designated UT Dallas toner/printer cartridge collection location.

plastic_wrap.instruction: Use a designated plastic film specialty recycling location only if the type is accepted.

raspberry_pi.instruction: UT Dallas provides designated campus electronics collection. Office equipment and bare Raspberry Pi boards need the campus responsible team's approval before drop-off.
raspberry_pi.condition: Campus-owned equipment and data-security requirements may apply.

profiles.name: H-E-B Main Street, Frisco — customer plastic-film collection
profiles.scope: H-E-B Main Street storefront CUSTOMER recycling bins for clean, dry plastic bags and eligible flexible film. Not the grocery store’s employee waste bins or rigid plastic recycling.
profiles.default_message: No documented acceptance for this item in H-E-B’s customer plastic-film bin. Do not place it there unless the official accepted-material list covers it.

plastic_grocery_bag.instruction: Bring clean, dry plastic shopping bags to the H-E-B front-of-store plastic-film bin.

produce_bag.instruction: Bring clean, dry produce bags to the H-E-B plastic-film bin.

bread_bag.instruction: Bring clean, dry bread bags to the H-E-B plastic-film bin.

soft_plastic_overwrap.instruction: Bring clean, dry flexible overwrap from water or paper-product multipacks.
soft_plastic_overwrap.condition: Film or flexible wrap, not rigid plastic packaging.

bubble_wrap.instruction: Bring clean, dry bubble wrap or plastic air pillows to the H-E-B plastic-film bin.
bubble_wrap.condition: No paper padding or food residue.

shipping_envelope_plastic.instruction: Bring clean, dry plastic delivery envelopes, including bubble-lined plastic mailers.
shipping_envelope_plastic.condition: Remove paper labels where practical; confirm the mailer is plastic film.

newspaper_bag.instruction: Use the H-E-B store plastic-film collection bin for clean, dry newspaper bags.

plastic_food_storage_bag.instruction: Use H-E-B film drop-off for clean, dry food storage and zipper bags.
plastic_food_storage_bag.condition: Must be free of food residue.

plastic_bottle.instruction: Rigid plastic bottles are not part of H-E-B’s plastic-film drop-off. Check your residential or local bottle recycling service.

milk_jug.instruction: H-E-B explicitly excludes milk jugs and bottles from its plastic-film bins.

candy_wrapper.instruction: Candy wrappers are excluded from H-E-B’s plastic-film collection.

compostable_bag.instruction: Compostable/biodegradable bags are not accepted in H-E-B’s plastic-film recycling bins.

frozen_food_bag.instruction: Frozen-vegetable and similar frozen-food bags are excluded.

pet_food_bag.instruction: Pet food bags are excluded from H-E-B’s film recycling program.

profiles.name: Best Buy Frisco — consumer electronics drop-off
profiles.scope: Consumer electronics CUSTOMER take-back program at Best Buy Frisco, a regular retail location. Personal household items only (no company/organization e-waste). Limits, fees and product exclusions apply; does not describe the store’s employee bin sorting.
profiles.default_message: This product is not confirmed for Best Buy Frisco consumer electronics recycling. Check Best Buy’s state-specific product list before visiting.

cell_phone.instruction: Eligible consumer mobile phones can be brought for Best Buy in-store electronics recycling.
cell_phone.condition: Residents only; check store eligibility and item limits; erase personal data before handoff.

laptop.instruction: Eligible consumer laptops can be brought for Best Buy in-store electronics recycling.
laptop.condition: Residents only; verify limits and store-specific rules; erase personal data first.

computer_keyboard.instruction: Computer keyboards are listed among devices accepted for Best Buy in-store recycling.
computer_keyboard.condition: Consumer items only; confirm store/program limits.

computer_mouse.instruction: Computer mice are listed among devices accepted for Best Buy in-store recycling.
computer_mouse.condition: Consumer items only; confirm store/program limits.

electrical_cable.instruction: Cables and connectors are among the accepted in-store consumer electronics.
electrical_cable.condition: Consumer items only; confirm store/program limits.

printer_cartridge.instruction: Ink/toner cartridges are listed among products accepted in Best Buy stores.
printer_cartridge.condition: Consumer items only; check store-specific limits.

standalone_battery.instruction: Best Buy generally lists stand-alone batteries as not accepted in its standard in-store program.
standalone_battery.condition: A limited small-rechargeable-battery exception is listed for California and New York; verify the exact state and product before drop-off.

raspberry_pi.instruction: Best Buy recycles many consumer computing devices but does not explicitly list loose Raspberry Pi boards. Contact the store to check this board before visiting.
raspberry_pi.condition: No claim of guaranteed bare-board acceptance.

profiles.name: Home Depot (North Frisco)
profiles.scope: North Frisco Home Depot customer drop-off program for selected plastic film, intact CFL bulbs and undamaged rechargeable batteries. Not employee waste-bin policy.
profiles.default_message: This Home Depot collection listing does not document accepting the scanned item. Do not put it in a store collection bin without confirming.

plastic_grocery_bag.instruction: Use the store's plastic-bag recycling collection for clean, eligible shopping bags.

plastic_wrap.instruction: Use the store's customer film-plastic bin if the wrap is clean and accepted.

cfl_bulb.instruction: Bring an unbroken compact fluorescent bulb to the dedicated CFL collection point; do not handle broken bulbs as normal recycling.

rechargeable_battery.instruction: Use the designated rechargeable battery collection for undamaged eligible batteries, following in-store safety instructions.
rechargeable_battery.condition: Damaged, swollen or leaking batteries need specialist guidance.

alkaline_battery.instruction: Home Depot says ordinary non-rechargeable alkaline AA/AAA batteries are not accepted in its rechargeable-battery collection bins.
alkaline_battery.condition: Use a suitable local household-battery collection program.

profiles.name: Staples (Frisco)
profiles.scope: Staples Frisco customer recycling program for specific electronics, cartridges, supplies and certain paid categories. Not the store's employee-bin policy.
profiles.default_message: Staples' published customer recycling list does not confirm acceptance of this item. Ask the store before drop-off.

printer_cartridge.instruction: Staples lists eligible ink and toner cartridges for customer recycling.

cell_phone.instruction: Staples lists mobile phones among eligible customer tech-recycling items; remove personal data first.

laptop.instruction: Staples lists laptops among recyclable customer technology; erase personal information before drop-off.

computer_keyboard.instruction: Staples lists computer keyboards and mice as eligible technology for customer recycling.

pen_marker.instruction: Staples lists pens, markers and highlighters in its customer school-supplies recycling categories.

binder.instruction: Staples lists empty binders for its customer school-supplies recycling program.

rechargeable_battery.instruction: Staples lists rechargeable batteries as a paid recycling category. Confirm eligibility and fee at the store.
rechargeable_battery.condition: Published price: $2.99 per visit in states where the fee applies, including Texas; verify current price.

alkaline_battery.instruction: Staples lists household single-use batteries in its paid recycling category. Ask a staff member about the eligible battery type and fee.
alkaline_battery.condition: Published fee is $2.99 per visit in Texas; damaged or leaking cells may need specialist handling.

raspberry_pi.instruction: Staples lists computers and small servers, but not bare Raspberry Pi circuit boards. Ask the store to confirm whether this board fits an accepted category.
raspberry_pi.condition: Do not put bare electronics in ordinary recycling.

profiles.name: Domino's Pizza (Frisco Preston Rd)
profiles.policy_type: consumer packaging instructions; local collection not verified
profiles.scope: Domino's published guidance for its corrugated pizza boxes. This is advice for the customer after eating, NOT proof the Frisco store has a customer recycling bin or that every local hauler accepts pizza boxes.
profiles.default_message: Domino's has not published a specific disposal rule for this scanned item in the guidance reviewed. Check local collection policies.

pizza_box.instruction: Empty Domino's corrugated pizza box and check whether your local paper/cardboard recycling program accepts pizza boxes. Typical grease marks do not automatically make the cardboard unrecyclable.
pizza_box.condition: Remove leftover food; local programs differ. Do not assume the restaurant has a take-back bin.

profiles.name: Starbucks (Frisco)
profiles.policy_type: customer reusable-cup policy; customer bin policy not verified
profiles.scope: Starbucks' official US reusable-cup ordering policy applies to company-operated and participating licensed stores. This is an option to PREVENT disposable cup waste, not permission to put a cup in a particular store bin.
profiles.default_message: Starbucks' published reusable-cup guidance does not establish a local bin destination for this item. Check store signs and the applicable waste service.

reusable_cup.instruction: Bring a clean personal reusable cup when buying a drink to avoid a single-use cup. Tell the barista or select Personal Cup when placing a supported order.
reusable_cup.condition: Participating location and ordering rules apply; dirty cups are not accepted.

reusable_mug.instruction: Use a clean travel mug or personal reusable tumbler for a new beverage order at a participating Starbucks store.
reusable_mug.condition: Personal cups must be clean; participating licensed stores can vary.

plastic_cold_cup.instruction: Starbucks says its US plastic cold cups have a widely recyclable label, but whether your particular collection program accepts this cup must be checked separately.
plastic_cold_cup.condition: Do not assume the café's bin or your home bin accepts this type of cup.

profiles.name: Texas Disposal Systems
profiles.policy_type: published recycling stream acceptance; customer enrollment not established
profiles.scope: Texas Disposal Systems publishes item-specific instructions for its recycling and trash services. The listed materials are NOT proof that a specific Texas workplace subscribes to TDS recycling service; follow that site's actual bins and contract.
profiles.default_message: TDS does not provide a documented sorting answer for this item in the items included in our pilot. Check its published Waste Wizard.

aluminum_tray.instruction: Texas Disposal Systems lists aluminum baking trays as accepted in its recycling stream. Empty the tray and check that your location uses a TDS recycling cart.
aluminum_tray.condition: Only at sites with a participating TDS recycling service; remove remaining food. Not an instruction for a non-TDS office.

aluminum_pie_plate.instruction: TDS accepts disposable aluminum pie plates in its recycling stream. Remove food first.
aluminum_pie_plate.condition: Only at sites served by an applicable TDS recycling program.

aluminum_can.instruction: TDS lists aluminum cans as accepted in its recycling stream.
aluminum_can.condition: Only at locations with TDS recycling pickup.

alkaline_battery.instruction: TDS says household batteries are not accepted in its ordinary recycling or trash carts. Use a designated household hazardous waste collection service.
alkaline_battery.condition: Never put loose household batteries in the recycling cart.

rechargeable_battery.instruction: TDS does not accept rechargeable batteries in normal recycling. Use a designated battery drop-off.
rechargeable_battery.condition: Check battery condition and facility-specific safe packaging requirements.

cell_phone.instruction: This program's regular mixed-material recycling cart is not an electronic-waste collection point. Seek an electronics recycler or special collection event.
cell_phone.condition: Verify a facility specifically handles devices.

profiles.name: DFW Electronics Recycling (Plano)
profiles.policy_type: professional electronic-waste drop-off; specific board type must be checked
profiles.scope: DFW Electronics Recycling advertises a Plano electronics drop-off and lists computer components, computer peripherals, phones and cabling. It does not specifically name Raspberry Pi boards or accept loose batteries under the published list.
profiles.default_message: The DFW Electronics Recycling published list doesn't specify this item. Call the recycler before bringing an unsupported or hazardous item.

raspberry_pi.instruction: A Raspberry Pi is a single-board computer; DFW Electronics Recycling lists computer components and parts. Contact the Plano site to confirm it accepts this exact bare board before drop-off.
raspberry_pi.condition: Remove any separate battery and memory containing sensitive data as appropriate. Do not put the board in an ordinary recycling bin.

circuit_board.instruction: The recycler lists computer components and parts. Ask whether your particular bare circuit board or PCB is eligible for electronics drop-off.
circuit_board.condition: Electronic boards are not accepted in mixed recycling.

cell_phone.instruction: DFW Electronics Recycling specifically lists cell phones for recycling. Use its electronics collection procedure and clear personal data first.
cell_phone.condition: Confirm location hours and any drop-off limits before visiting.

laptop.instruction: DFW Electronics Recycling lists computers and computer equipment. Ask about laptop acceptance at its Plano drop-off, and erase personal data.
laptop.condition: Small load limit applies at the Plano drop-off.

electrical_cable.instruction: DFW Electronics Recycling lists wire and cabling for electronics recycling.
electrical_cable.condition: Bring to an electronics collection location, not mixed recycling.

computer_keyboard.instruction: DFW Electronics Recycling lists computer peripherals for recycling.
computer_keyboard.condition: Verify it is a household/electronic peripheral, not hazardous waste.
